title: P256 fused emission, no forward zero test

claims.statement: For the protected full-production P256 target, the complete cold classical algorithm in proof.md and supporting documents recovers the scalar with probability at least0.39 using at most99589378659783168429944885261473765392384 scalar instruction equivalents, below2^126.227331395977596 group units at C1000. q1=377468911,q2=2^28,N=2^70. Includes all construction, normalization, range-tree control, capped carry/failure costs, fixed block-window transport with transaction-bound ACK events, grouping, explicit resolution, verification and output. Peak memory below2^136bytes; preprocessing below2^118units included; no advice or auxiliary powers. Analytical bound under the stated ideal-coin and blocking-port machine, not production execution or formal certification. Adds fused emission (2549/4) and removes the forward zero test (465/4, garbage completion); 2958 fixed per row.
